journey.name: contacts list loading
journey.description:
Contacts shows the saved contacts as soon as it opens after a relaunch, under the names they were saved with, and fills in each contact's profile name and avatar as its lookup finishes. It no longer shows a spinner over an empty list until every lookup has finished, and a lookup that fails leaves the row as it is. Within the session, reopening Contacts shows the profiles already found straight away. Opening a contact whose profile has not loaded yet looks it up at once, and its edit form shows the contact's published bio rather than an empty one, so saving an edit keeps it.
Precondition: an onboarded E2E Bitkit build with Paykit UI enabled and a Pubky identity with at least five saved contacts, at least one of them with a published profile name and bio and one with no published profile. Importing such follows with journeys/contacts/import-all-contacts.xml leaves exactly that. Use the test simulator UDID for <UDID>.
A warm network can resolve every profile before the first snapshot; report "already resolved" rather than failing. See README.md.

actions.action: If the PIN screen appears, unlock the wallet
Tap the menu button (id "HeaderMenu"), then Contacts (id "DrawerContacts")

Verify the list shows one row (id "Contact_<pubky>") per saved contact, each with a name, and no spinner over an empty list. A contact whose profile has not loaded yet shows the name it was saved with, or its truncated key

Tap the row of a contact with a published bio straight away and verify its contact screen shows that bio (id "ContactViewNotes") within a few seconds. Tap Edit (id "ContactEdit") and verify the notes field shows the same bio, then tap Cancel (id "ProfileEditCancel") and go back (id "NavigationBack")
Wait up to a minute and verify each contact with a published profile now shows its profile name, and its avatar if it has one. If every row already did, report "already resolved"
Verify a contact with no published profile still shows the name it had when the list opened
Tap a contact's row and verify its contact screen opens with that contact's name, then go back
Verify Contacts shows every row straight away with the profile names it showed before, with no row back on a truncated key
